Welcome 9 AM – 8 PM (Mon-Thurs) 9 AM – 5 PM (Fri) & 9 AM – 3 PM (Sat) Book Online Welcome to Family Dental Station in Glendale, AZ From boring offices to inconsiderate pokes and prods, there are plenty of reasons to put off going to the dentist in Glendale, AZ . At Family Dental Station, we’re thrilled to provide you with an exceptional and experienced family dentist in Glendale, AZ. With a warm welcome, intriguing vintage fire station decor, and personalized, comfort-focused dental care, we strive to remove the anxiety and monotony of dental work. So, take a look around, unwind, and give your smile the attention it deserves. book an appointment Meet Our Dentist Meet Dr. Arthurs At Family Dental Station, we believe that a visit to the Glendale dentist should be as pleasant and stress-free as possible. That’s why our dental offices were designed to keep patient comfort in mind. We’ll address any concerns you might have before dental treatment and answer all of your questions in a relaxed, pressure-free setting. We’re accepting new patients at our dental office at 5664 West Bell Rd, Glendale, AZ 85308 , so call us: 602-978-3500 book now Comprehensive Dental Services Tailored to Your Needs dental emergency Dental Implants Teeth Whitening View More Services Secure Healthy Smiles for the Entire Family 1 2 3 Make an appointment. With flexible scheduling, we’ll find a time that works for your family. Relax and enjoy. Intriguing firehouse decor, a peaceful lounge, and great service just might make your day. Celebrate those pearly whites. The world needs more happy, healthy smiles! We’ll keep yours shining for the long haul. It took me awhile, but I finally made appointments for my entire family. We all were quite impressed with the overall look of the office and the friendliness of the staff. The service and care from the dental team and Doctor was excellent. I have anxiety when it comes to dental work. The Doc and staff made sure to take the necessary steps to ensure my appts were comfortable. I highly recommend Family Dental to anyone looking for a dentist. candy s. Dr. Arthurs and his team at Family Dental Station are truly outstanding! Admittedly I have never enjoyed going to the dentist before, but that’s because I’d never been to Family Dental Station! These guys are amazing! Every single team member I encounter did their best to make my experience as pleasant and easy as possible! Sorry I didnt catch everyone’s name but I wanted to give a shout out to Dr Arthurs, Dr. Bhakta, Mara, Madeline, and everyone who helped me today! Thank you so much! Ron A. I have never felt so comfortable at a denists office as I did at FAMILY DENTAL STATION in Glendale today. The entire staff was EXCELLENT. I am looking forward to my next appointment to discuss my procedures that I will need to get my dental issues taken care of. I was very impressed with the Honesty and the time they took to explain everything to me. Thank you very much. Cinda My children and I have gone to Family Dental Station for a couple of years now and love it! They are very friendly, patient, and have done a great job caring for our teeth! They do an excellent job at making it an inviting and comfortable place. Which I feel is important especially for children. My boys love going and have a positive association with going to the dentist and having good oral hygiene.
